summary: Planban 1.1.3 makes agent activity visible on the Work Items being accessed, prevents live updates from starving Board loading, and simplifies the Board and detail surfaces around sight and portable agent handoff.
updatePrompt: Install or update Planban from piercekearns/planban. Verify the plugin and MCP tools, open an existing board at its 127.0.0.1 URL, confirm it loads promptly, use a Planban card tool while the Board is visible to verify the card activity treatment, and review the simplified Board header, card actions, fixed detail header, History menu, tutorial, and feedback flow.
changelogSummary: Visible agent activity, reliable Board loading, and a calmer, more portable Planban surface.
